subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should VALUE.md become a core first-class bootstrap/context file with default seeding and workspace-file priority semantics, or should value guidance stay in existing files or an opt-in configurable bootstrap-file API?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the change adds a new default prompt/context surface and priority rule; the direct implementation was closed as broad product/design work rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Prefer configurable context files
options.body: Resolve the arbitrary/session-scoped bootstrap-file contract and let users opt into VALUE.md without adding another hardcoded core semantic file.

options.title: Sponsor first-class VALUE.md
options.body: Accept the convention and request a fresh focused PR that updates every first-class workspace-file surface and documents precedence clearly.

options.title: Keep existing files only
options.body: Decline the new surface and document that value orientation belongs in SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, or MEMORY.md depending on lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Prefer configurable context files
recommendation.body: Resolve the arbitrary/session-scoped bootstrap-file contract and let users opt into VALUE.md without adding another hardcoded core semantic file.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest maintainer product/design signal on the closed direct implementation PR.
